sections.line: PrompTugal's investment case rewritten for sovereign websites: one deliverable needed everywhere.

sections.label: In short
sections.line: Same structure, a market of rent, a one-off agentic delivery, value first, upsells, velocity as the moat.

sections.line: PrompTugal's fifteen-slide case and its no-invented-statistic rule carry over almost part for part.

sections.label: The problem
sections.line: Small businesses rent their websites, locked in by the builders' own terms.

sections.label: Our answer
sections.line: Built by agents, owned by you, with CI, tests, security, a policy and a team inside.

sections.label: Why it can be profitable

sections.label: The moat
